# agg_advisors_daily

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.agg_advisors_daily` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Daily advisor activity snapshot built on a date spine from signup through today. Calculates metrics such as daily booking counts, commissionable value, commission and subscription revenue, plus trailing 365-day rolling metrics via window functions. Default metrics include canceled bookings; non-canceled versions are available with a 'non_canceled_' prefix. Each row represents a single advisor on a single calendar date. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_daily_id` | A surrogate key created from the user_id and calendar_date field for each row in the table  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_growth_or_lifestyle_segment` | Growth vs. Lifestyle designation for Advisors with $100K+ trailing 365d CBV. An advisor is Growth if they have 5+ booked clients (including canceled) in the trailing 365d AND either (a) trailing 365d CBV $1.5M+, or (b) trailing 365d CBV is $100K-$1.5M and 50%+ year-over-year growth, or (c) trailing 365d CBV is $100K-$1.5M and has no prior-year comparison. All other advisors at or above $100K are Lifestyle; Advisors below $100K are labeled as such. Overridden by a manual tag from the advisor_segment_tags Google Sheet when one applies on this date.  >>  SOURCE - Portal + Google Sheets |
| `advisor_id` | user_id for the Advisor  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_year_over_year_growth_segment` | Year-over-year growth band as of the given date, based on trailing 365d CBV this year vs. prior year. High-speed growth (100%+ YoY), Medium-high growth (50-100% YoY), Slow growth (0-50% YoY), Flat or decline (<0% YoY), or New advisor (no prior-year comparison). Independent from the Growth or Lifestyle definition and manual tags.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
